messages:
Lina (Release): starting a ribbon-rollout for v3.0.0 across api-search (eu-west) and api-embeds (us-east). initial traffic: 6% on search eu-west, 2% on embeds us-east. change window 16:00-17:00 UTC. primary watches: p95/p99 latency, 5xx, tokenization drift, and embed similarity.
Raj: copy. release notes: https://release.redwood/v/3.0.0. I've queued the cross-region pins. running quick smoke now.
deploy-bot: deploy: v3.0.0 -> api-search initiated. target=6% region=eu-west started_at=3344556705. status=rolling
deploy-bot: deploy: v3.0.0 -> api-embeds initiated. target=2% region=us-east started_at=3344556712. status=rolling
Tess SRE: infra: adding soft safety cutoff: if any host sees 5xx > 1.6% sustained 6m OR p99 +110ms sustained 6m -> auto-cut to 0% for that region. also set edge-pool concurrency cap for search-canary to 3 to limit warmup pressure.
Samir (ML): running relevance and embedding tail checks now. will post delta table in ~8m. also watching for tokenization changes with latest tokenizer patch.
Theo: note that api-search long-context calls could show higher kv-cache churn; I recommend holding search at 6% for 10m before advancing.
Lina (Release): agreed hold. pin routes and do not advance until cross-region signals are green. Raj please pin and annotate: ribbon=dual-region, safety=cutoff-rule.
Raj: pin commands I'll run: ```bash
redwood route pin --route api-search --version v3.0.0 --percent 6 --region eu-west --note "ribbon:dual-region"
redwood route pin --route api-embeds --version v3.0.0 --percent 2 --region us-east --note "ribbon:dual-region"
```
deploy-bot: routing: api-search pinned to v3.0.0 at 6% eu-west by Raj at 3344556738. routing: api-embeds pinned to v3.0.0 at 2% us-east by Raj at 3344556740. notes=safety_cutoff_enabled,concurrency_cap=3
Tess SRE: applying concurrency cap: ```bash
redwood infra set-concurrency --pool search-canary-eu --max 3
```
Samir (ML): initial eval: search relevance neutral overall, but one edge family shows -4.4% MRR in eu-west sample (high variance). embeds recall +0.8% in us-east. attaching short sample diffs.
Tess SRE: infra log link: https://logs.redwood/canary/3344556677. seeing modest kv-cache evictions on two search canaries. opening INF-4472.
Lina (Release): because of the -4.4% tail in search we keep search pinned at 6% and hold. do not increase. embeds looks fine so far. Samir, can you triage that edge family and see if it's data-dependent or model behavior?
Samir (ML): will run a focused regression sweep on that family. initial hypothesis: tokenizer patch changed field-splitting in a sub-case. pushing a localized test.
Theo: ops note: if we need to cut traffic quickly use deploy-bot auto-cut command or manual rollback. auto-cut will move region to 0% for affected region only. Manual rollback target: v2.9.6 for both routes if we decide revert.
Lina (Release): rollback rules: auto-cut on safety thresholds above. manual rollback if product lead concurs or if MRR tail < -3% sustained 10m. tie-break owner: Lina. If we rollback open incident and attach promoted samples.
Raj: manual rollback commands saved: ```bash
redwood deploy rollback --route api-search --to-version v2.9.6 --region eu-west --reason "canary tail MRR regression"
redwood deploy rollback --route api-embeds --to-version v2.9.6 --region us-east --reason "canary regression"
```
deploy-bot: monitor update at 3344556899: search_error_rate=1.12% search_p99_delta=54ms search_mrr_delta=-4.4% embeds_error_rate=0.2% embeds_p99_delta=12ms embeds_recall_delta=+0.8% status=held
Tess SRE: no auto-cut triggered yet but I'm watching infra metrics. INF-4472 shows two hosts with elevated evictions; will rotate those hosts out of canary pool if it persists.
Samir (ML): quick update after targeted repro: tokenizer split occurs when query contains nested JSON-like text. I have a mitigation: adjust tokenizer config on canary variant to use legacy-split for that family and re-run for only the affected search traffic subset. Thoughts?
Theo: if we can target only that family via routing rules to a model-variant, do it. Otherwise prefer rollback. Routing by prompt-set needs engineering signoff.
Lina (Release): avoid rollback if we can hot-fix with a targeted variant. Raj, can you and Samir prototype a variant pin for that prompt-family at low percent (1-2%) while keeping main search at 6%? If variant doesn't help, we'll rollback.
Raj: plan: create model variant v3.0.0-legacy-tok and pin 1% for affected prompt-set using route filters. I'll coordinate with infra. Command (prototype): ```bash
redwood route pin --route api-search --version v3.0.0-legacy-tok --percent 1 --filter "prompt_family:edge-json"
```
deploy-bot: note: feature flagging/filter-routing enabled for route api-search. awaiting pin by Raj.
Lina (Release): reconvene in 12m for go/no-go. I'll post an interim update to #release-updates. If variant reduces MRR tail to within -1.5% we'll advance; otherwise we roll back. :hourglass:
